model_annotations.Bulgarian: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy values for different models—DAPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, SRPO, and PPO—across three datasets: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis represents the datasets, labeled “Mathverse,” “MMLU,” and “Physics” in that order, while the vertical axis represents accuracy, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, with a linear scale ranging from 50% to 62% and tick marks at 2% intervals. For each dataset, there are five bars representing the accuracy of each model. The “DAPO+Self-reflection” bars are blue, with heights of approximately 55.5%, 57%, and 61.5% for Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics, respectively. The “GRPO” bars are orange, with heights of approximately 53%, 55%, and 59.5%. The “PPO+Self-reflection” bars are light blue, with heights of approximately 56.5%, 56.5%, and 60%. The “SRPO” bars are red, with heights of approximately 54.5%, 54.5%, and 57%. The “PPO” bars are green, with heights of approximately 52.5%, 55%, and 56%. The bars are arranged in groups corresponding to each dataset, and are not sorted in any particular order within each group. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
model_annotations.Chinese: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy values for different models—DAPO+Self-reflection, Dapo, SRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO—across three datasets: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis represents the datasets, labeled “Mathverse,” “MMLU,” and “Physics” in that order, with no apparent sorting. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, displays a linear scale ranging from 50% to 62%, with tick marks at 2% intervals. For each dataset, there are five bars representing the accuracy of each model. The “DAPO+Self-reflection” bars are light blue, with heights of approximately 55.5%, 57%, and 61.5% for Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics, respectively. The “DAPO” bars are medium blue, reaching approximately 54.5%, 56.5%, and 58.5% for the same datasets. The “SRPO” bars are orange, with heights of about 53%, 55%, and 55% across the three datasets. “PPO+Self-reflection” is represented by green bars, measuring approximately 55%, 58%, and 60.5%. Finally, the “PPO” bars are diagonally striped orange, with heights of roughly 52.5%, 54.5%, and 57.5%. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
